description: The performance of the E8 is very good, and all configurations are from the original factory. It comes with a pair of pedals that you can use when your e-bike runs out of battery.【UL certified 48V17.5Ah Battery】Equipped with 840WH large Li-ion battery, the electric mountain bike allows a longer range riding, up to 30 miles(pure electric)-70 miles(pedal assist) per charge. The removable battery makes it easy to charge, whether at home or work (8 hours fully charged). UL listed and IP67 waterproof ensure safety.【750W Electric Bike/85N·M/Up to 34MPH】Equipped with a powerful 750W gear hub motor, which provides massive amounts of 85Nm torque when powering up steep hills or accelerating quickly from a dead stop. With 1000W of peak motor power, you can easily conquer the most rugged terrains, and dominate any e-bike mountain bike trail. It is the best choice for off-road, mountain, outdoor, and long-distance travel. Get your E8S and keep wild on E·Bycco!【5 Riding Modes & Intuitive LCD Display】As a Class 3 e-bike, this pedal electric bike has 5 riding modes: Normal Riding/Pedal Assist/Full Throttle/Cruise Mode/Walking Assist. Pedal Assist has 5 different levels. Equipped with an intelligent waterproof LCD to adjust the Pedal-Assist Level and display essential information such as Speed, Level of Assistance, Battery Life, and Trip Distance.【Ergonomic Design & Professional Parts】Ergonomic design of this pedal electric bike offers you a safe and comfortable ride. Our E8S electric bicycle comes with a headlight, horn, fender, phone holder with USB charging port, intelligent LCD, metal pedals, adjustable saddle, and solid kickstand, the electric road bike features a neat and sleek look.【29"*2.1" All Terrain Tire & 330LBS Capacity】E8 pedal electric bike with 29x 2.1-inch all-terrain tires, it can traverse all sorts of terrain, including mountains, snow, beach, rocky roads, and even urban jungles. Lockable aluminum dual shock absorber for less bump on rough roads. The dual mechanical disc brakes deliver optimal durability and safety. The bike weighs 55 lbs and has a max load capacity of 330 lbs.【90% Assembled】Please watch the installation video on the page. The package includes the bike, installation tools, charger, keys, fenders, and a manual. Assembling the 95% built bike is quite simple. If you encounter any issues, please don’t hesitate to contact us.【2024 Upgrade】The electric bike upgrade is based on the feedback and experience of buyers! From E8 to E8S, we upgraded to the larger capacity battery, thicker tires, and the inner tube in 2024. All accessories are easily available. We are the source manufacturer, so you don’t have to worry about not being able to buy replacement parts in the future. Act quickly and get this best electric bike for the money.
